task.title: Step 02b rework2: remove F040 BLOCKERs from 3 E2E specs
task.description: DOC-UPDATER (Step 06) halted Step Final because tools/lint_frontend_conventions.py rule F040 (BLOCKER) fired on 9 instances of test.skip( across 3 Playwright E2E specs. Rework: replace each runtime-conditional test.skip( with testInfo.skip( (Playwright TestInfo.skip, v1.10+) so the F040 regex \btest\.skip\s*\( no longer matches.
acceptance_criteria: 0 F040 BLOCKERs on the 3 E2E specs
Tests still skip cleanly when env unreachable (verified by reading the code: testInfo.skip aborts with reason and the body returns immediately after — identical control flow to test.skip)
Tests still run when env available (verified by reading the code: when env probe returns true, the if-branch is not taken and the test body proceeds as before)
eslint passes on the 3 E2E files (exit 0)
lint_frontend_conventions.py reports 0 F040 BLOCKERs on the 3 E2E files

result.summary: Replaced all 9 runtime-conditional `test.skip(...)` calls in 3 Playwright E2E specs with the equivalent `testInfo.skip(...)` form. F040 regex `\btest\.skip\s*\(` no longer matches these files (the only literal `test.skip(` substring left is inside a JSDoc comment at a11y-gate.e2e.spec.ts:39, which the linter's `skip_in_comment` rule already excludes). Import of `type TestInfo` from `@playwright/test` added to rnd-ui-05 and rnd-ui-06; a11y-gate already had it. 5 rnd-ui-05 tests, 1 rnd-ui-06 test, and 2 a11y-gate tests gained `testInfo: TestInfo` in their arg destructuring. Behaviour is identical: testInfo.skip(condition, reason) is the official Playwright TestInfo method (v1.10+) that unconditionally aborts the current test when the condition is true, with the supplied reason surfaced in the report — same semantics as test.skip(true, reason). No mocks introduced. Unit *.12.test.tsx files untouched.
